title: Package an SDK-style .NET library
prerequisites: Docker is required for this Linux amd64 isolated recipe. Run oyzu pin to lock oyzu:dotnet (SDK 10.0.401 by default), then oyzu build --isolated. Oyzu restores the locked SDK into the container and pulls oyzu-execution/base:1 by digest; no separately provisioned SDK executor or host-installed .NET SDK is required. Historical verification records do not verify this locked-tool flow.
